description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Michael Selig weighs in on prediction markets, insider trading enforcement and the outlook for crypto legislation. Port of Los Angeles Executive Director Gene Seroka says shipping firms are taking a "wait and see" approach to US efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Representative Adam Smith (D-WA), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, criticizes the administration's Iran strategy. They all speak from the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills, California. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump's 'Project Freedom' Fans Tensions | Balance of Power: Late Edition 05/04/2026

description: Representative Adam Smith (D-WA), Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Committee, criticizes the administration's Iran strategy, saying there is "not much evidence" further military escalation would force Tehran to capitulate and arguing the threat of a nuclear weapon was "not imminent" before the campaign began. On the administration's "Project Freedom" plan, he says it is "highly unlikely" insurers will allow commercial ships to transit the Strait of Hormuz despite US protection. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power: Late Edition" from the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills, California. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Rep. Smith: Iran Nuclear Threat Wasn't Imminent

description: Port of Los Angeles Executive Director Gene Seroka says shipping firms are taking a "wait and see" approach to US efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as security risks and rising insurance and freight costs deter traffic. He warns the real supply impact is still ahead, as higher fuel and diesel costs continue to pressure supply chains and small trucking operators. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power: Late Edition" from the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills, California. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Seroka: Shipping Firms in "Wait and See" Mode

description: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Michael Selig weighed in on prediction markets, insider trading enforcement and the outlook for crypto legislation. He said Congress is "at the finish line" on a compromise crypto market structure bill and hopes it can reach the president's desk by July 4. Selig defended the CFTC's oversight of prediction markets, applauding exchanges like Kalshi for tightening user requirements and stressing the agency's "zero tolerance" policy on insider trading and market manipulation. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power: Late Edition" at the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills, California. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: CFTC's Selig: Hopeful CLARITY Act Can Pass by July 4

description: Democratic Senator Angela Alsobrooks said the government and private industry need to work together to address longstanding hurdles to creating generational wealth, including the increasingly high barriers to home ownership. Talking live from the Milken Global Conference, Alsobooks said that she is open to hearing ideas from 'all sides,' including leaders in business and finance. Alsobrooks also discussed the status of stablecoin legislation in the Senate, saying that the bipartisan compromise bill she has worked on with Senator Thom Tillis is aimed at allowing innovation while protecting community banks. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Government, Industry Need 'Partnership' to Address Affordability Concerns, Says Alsobrooks

author: Nancy Cook
description: Some conservatives are conflicted about the war and the economy.
title: Kentucky Republicans Flashing Warning Signs for GOP Candidates

author: Catherine Lucey
description: President Donald Trump said he’s looking forward to meeting Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, signaling that his plans for the high-stakes summit are still on despite fresh tensions between the world’s two largest economies.
title: Trump Says He Looks Forward to Xi Summit Even as Tensions Mount

description: WASHINGTON (AP) — A man spotted carrying a gun in the vicinity of the White House by plainclothes officers and agents was shot by law enforcement Monday after he opened fire on them near the Washington Monument, the Secret Service said.
title: Secret Service Agents Exchange Fire With Gunman Near Washington Monument

author: Kamil Kowalcze, Nick Heubeck, Jorge Valero
description: The European Union is in talks with Anthropic PBC about getting its companies and banks tested for any vulnerabilities that the new Mythos AI model uncovers.
title: EU in Talks With Anthropic to Get Banks Tested for Mythos Flaws

author: Nick Heubeck, Jorge Valero, Kamil Kowalcze
description: European Union Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis warned of the stagflationary effect that the Iran war is creating for the bloc.
title: Europe Is Facing Stagflationary Shock, EU’s Dombrovskis Says

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power,  Bloomberg's Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar discuss the geopolitical risk put in play by war with Iran and how business leaders are handling the economic impact. On today's show, partner at Oliver Wyman and senior fellow at the Atlantic Council Daniel Tannebaum and Democrat Senator from Maryland Angela Alsobrooks. Also, Bloomberg's Romain Bostick and Katie Greifeld talk to Chevron CEO Mike Wirth. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Business Leaders Talk Geopolitical Risk at Milken | Balance of Power: Early Edition 5/04/2026

author: Courtney Subramanian
description: The Trump administration is considering an executive order to create a working group on artificial intelligence, according to the New York Times, a bid to boost oversight of the emerging technology.
title: White House Eyes Vetting AI Models Pre-Release, NYTimes Says

description: US Senator Ted Cruz, chairman of the Senate Commerce Committee and a Republican from Texas, talks about the war in Iran and rising gasoline prices with Bloomberg Television at the Milken Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Is Imposing Economic Pain on Iran, Cruz Says

author: Chris Strohm
description: The US Justice Department has asked a federal judge to throw out his ruling that blocked prosecutors from using grand jury subpoenas during their investigation into building-cost overruns by the Federal Reserve.
title: DOJ’s Pirro Asks Judge to Toss Earlier Ruling on Fed Subpoenas

author: Andrey Lemeshko
description: Russia unilaterally declared a ceasefire in its war on Ukraine to coincide with its traditional May 9 parade marking the defeat of Nazi Germany in World War II.
title: Russia Warns Ukraine of Retaliation If May 9 Parade Targeted

author: Jimmy Jenkins
description: A federal judge said Monday he was “disturbed” after learning the man accused of attempting to assassinate President Donald Trump at a recent Washington gala is being held in solitary confinement in addition to other restrictive conditions while in custody.
title: Judge ‘Disturbed’ by Alleged Gala Shooter’s Prison Conditions

description: Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman says he feels “not great” about New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and his idea of taxing billionaires like Ken Griffin on their second homes here. Ackman tells Bloomberg Television that Mamdani should not be trying to drive Griffin out of New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Ackman Says Mamdani Should Not Force Griffin Out of NYC

author: Donato Paolo Mancini
description: Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni vowed closer cooperation with Azerbaijan as part of a broader energy diplomacy effort to address the supply squeeze caused by the Iran war.
title: Italy’s Meloni Vows Closer Ties With Azerbaijan in Energy Push

description: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth has told the Trump administration that global oil supplies are “tightening” due to the Strait of Hormuz closure. He speaks to Bloomberg Television at the annual Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Shipping Security in Hormuz Is a Concern, Chevron CEO Says

author: Alex Ebert
description: Liberal voters are suing Florida, alleging that new a congressional map signed Monday by Gov. Ron DeSantis (R) violates a state constitutional provision against political gerrymandering.
title: Florida Sued Over DeSantis‑Backed Congressional Map Favoring GOP

description: Pershing Square founder and CEO Bill Ackman says succession at the company is already in place. Speaking with Bloomberg's Dani Burger at the Milken Institute Global Conference in Beverly Hills, California, Ackman also discusses his bid for Universal Music Group, the rise of prediction markets and offers his views on New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Ackman Talks Succession Plan, Universal Music Bid and Mamdani

author: Maria Eloisa Capurro
description: Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams said the US central bank’s current stance balances risks to price stability and full employment amid “notable” supply-chain disruptions from the Iran war.
title: Fed’s Williams Says Rates Well Positioned Amid War Uncertainty

author: Michael Nienaber
description: Germany is assessing how to fill a potential defense gap if the US scales back missile deployments in Europe, warning it could weaken NATO’s deterrence against Russia.
title: Germany Looks to Plug Gaps in Defenses If US Drops Missile Plan

title: US Has Opened a Passage Through Hormuz, Central Command Says

author: Abeer Abu Omar
description: Iran attacked the United Arab Emirates for the first time in almost a month on Monday, as tensions between the US and Islamic Republic rose.

description: As currency traders continue to watch for potential Japanese moves to buy the yen, a Finance Ministry official from the nation on Monday cited a rule saying that three days of intervention count as a single operation.

description:
Indian PM Narendra Modi’s party has secured its first-ever election victory in the eastern Indian state of West Bengal.

The victory bolsters Modi’s standing as the nation’s most popular leader and expands the BJP's support base across the country. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Modi’s BJP Sees Milestone Win in State Election

author: Myles Miller
description: The Trump administration lifted a visa processing freeze for foreign physicians, ending a months-long halt that had sidelined thousands of doctors and exacerbated staffing shortages at hospitals across the country.
title: Trump Ends Visa Freeze That Exacerbated Foreign Doctor Shortage

author: Greg Stohr
description: The US Supreme Court temporarily paused a lower court decision that would require patients to visit a healthcare provider in person to get a widely used abortion pill.
title: Supreme Court Pauses Ruling That Restricts Abortion Pill by Mail

author: Omar Tamo, Arsalan Shahla
description: The United Arab Emirates on Monday issued a missile threat warning for the first time since a ceasefire between the US and Iran took hold about a month ago, underscoring the fragility of diplomatic efforts to end a war that has killed thousands and disrupted global energy supplies.
title: UAE Issues Missile Warning as Rising Tensions Risk US-Iran Truce

description: The US says a Navy ship was not hit by Iranian missiles then forced to retreat near the Gulf of Oman. Meanwhile, the White House says the US will escort any stranded ships trying to go through the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Says Navy Ship Was Not Hit by Iranian Missiles

title: Bessent Calls on China, Allies to Join US Operation in Hormuz

title: Germany’s Klingbeil Renews Call for EU Windfall Tax on Energy

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government unveiled measures worth C$1.5 billion ($1.1 billion) to help Canadian firms hurt by the Trump administration’s changes to US tariffs on imports containing steel, aluminum and copper.
title: Canada Giving $1.1 Billion to Firms Hit by US Metal Tariff Rules

author: Jorge Valero, Kamil Kowalcze, Nick Heubeck
description: Europe will consider all retaliatory options should US President Donald Trump follow through on his threat to raise tariffs on cars and trucks from the European Union to 25%, the bloc’s finance ministers said.
title: EU Vows Action If Trump Adopts Car Tariffs, But Urges Restraint

author: Andrea Palasciano, Ania Nussbaum, Ani Avetisyan
description: Some of the US’s closest allies including Canada and the UK are warning that the international system of security and trade championed by western powers for more than 70 years is broken beyond repair — and that it’s up to Europe to fashion a new global order.
title: US Allies Look to Europe to Build a Post-Trump Global Order

description: These issues facing both parties are likely to decide who wins in November

description: Some Asian refiners offered to buy Upper Zakum crude from the United Arab Emirates at around $20 a barrel above official prices, as processors scramble for medium-sour grades after the Iran war disrupted supply.
title: Asian Buyers Offer Big Premium for Diesel-Rich Crude From UAE

author: Anthony Halpin
description: A drone hit a residential tower in an upscale Moscow district in a rare strike near the city center ahead of the traditional World War II Victory Day parade.

title: Indian States Begin Counting Votes in Key Elections

description: President Donald Trump has said the US will begin guiding some neutral ships trapped in the Persian Gulf out through the Strait of Hormuz starting Monday. Bloomberg TV's Joumanna Bercetche hosts Deputy Bureau Chief Abeer Abu Omar who breaks down the latest developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US to Guide Trapped Ships Through Hormuz

description:
Jason Hsu, Senior Fellow at Hudson Institute and a former KMT party lawmaker in Taiwan, says Beijing is using a two-pronged approach on Taiwan. He also discusses concerns over the self-ruled island being "on the menu" of expected talks between Presidents Xi and Trump later this month. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Ex-Taiwan Lawmaker warns of China’s 'Dangerous' Strategy

title: Singapore and New Zealand Sign Essential Supply Trade Pact

description: A North Korean women’s football team is set to visit South Korea this month for an Asian Football Confederation Women’s Champions League semi-final, marking a rare instance of cross-border engagement even as diplomatic ties between the two Koreas remain frozen.
title: N Korean Women’s Soccer Team Plan First Game in South Since 2014

title: Swiss Lawmakers Gather to Discuss Law That Will Shape UBS Future

author: Alfred Cang, Winnie Zhu, Nectar Gan

title: China’s Rare Sanctions Pushback Leaves Banks Caught in Crossfire

author: Ani Avetisyan, Michael Nienaber
description: Nearly 50 European leaders will gather in Armenia Monday to discuss pressing issues for the continent, such as democratic resilience and energy security. But the meeting will likely be overshadowed by recent comments by Donald Trump that threaten to send transatlantic relations to a new low.
title: European Leaders Meet as Trump Adds More Threats: What to Watch
